source.citation: Bridoux F, Chen N, Moreau S, Arnulf B, Moumas E, Abraham J, Desport E, Jaccard A, Fermand JP. Pharmacokinetics, safety, and efficacy of lenalidomide plus dexamethasone in patients with multiple myeloma and renal impairment. Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2016;78:173-182.

file.name: Bridoux, et al., Cancer Chemother Pharmacol. 2016.pdf

source.storage: Supplied by the platform owner; kept on her computer, not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the PDF text layer (pdftotext). Only 'Materials and methods' and Table 1 were read for this stage. Independent review pending.

population.value: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (IMWG criteria), at least 1 prior line, stable renal function (up to 20% deviation from baseline creatinine clearance over the 28-day prescreening); no prior lenalidomide; amyloidosis, hepatic impairment, acute kidney injury and peritoneal dialysis excluded.
population.location: Materials and methods, Study design and patients (page 174)

renal_function_measure.value: Creatinine clearance by Cockcroft-Gault from serum creatinine (alkaline picrate colorimetric assay); eGFR by the 4-variable MDRD equation also reported.

per_group.note: Table 1 lists enrolled patients; the number with pharmacokinetic data per group is in the header of Table 2 and is read at stage 2.

lenalidomide.esrd: 5 mg once daily, days 1-21, after haemodialysis on dialysis days

doses.escalation: Moderate could go to 15 mg daily and severe to 10 mg daily after 2 cycles (not relevant to the day 5 sampling).

pk_sampling.value: Predose and 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 24 h after the dose on day 5 (window days 4-7); also predose and 2 h on day 15 (dexamethasone day) and day 19 (no dexamethasone).

bioanalytical_method.value: Lenalidomide in plasma 'measured as described previously' (reference 14); not described in this article.

pk_analysis.value: Non-compartmental (WinNonlin): Cmax, Tmax, AUC 0-24 h (AUC24), terminal half-life, CL/F, Vz/F; linear regression of CL/F on CrCl and eGFR; ANOVA of CL/F by renal group; percent ratio of geometric means (moderate, severe, ESRD versus normal plus mild) with 90% CIs for CL/F.
pk_analysis.summary_statistic_of_auc: to be read at stage 2 from Table 2 (mean or geometric mean)

comparison_study.value: Data from the 30-patient single 25 mg dose study in non-malignant renal impairment (reference 14) were included for comparison.

not_reported: Body weight (no group or study-wide values)

fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.creatinine_clearance: normal distribution with the group's mean and SD, truncated to the group definition (normal 80-140, mild 50-80, moderate 30-50, severe 10-30 mL/min; no observed ranges reported)
fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.age_years: uniform within each group's reported range
fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.weight_kg: not reported per group or study-wide: uniform 55-95 kg
fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.height_cm: not reported: men 165-185, women 152-172; the 'sensitivity_shorter' scenario applies
fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.exposure_measure: expected to be rule (1) or (3): AUC24 on day 5 at the label-adjusted dose; confirmed at stage 2 from Table 2
fallbacks_triggered_by_the_locked_plan.reference_group: normal renal function, unless Table 2 pools normal and mild for the AUC comparison

deviation.what: While locating Table 1 in the column-layout text, the lines printed below the table included part of the Results text in the facing column. Seen before this file was committed: mean AUC24 of the mild, moderate, severe and ESRD groups as 149%, 103%, 133% and 116% of the normal group; the mild group's mean AUC24 of 2605 h ng/mL (2260 without 3 patients); the CL/F regression slope on CrCl (2.12 in myeloma versus 2.28 in non-malignant renal impairment); R2 values for CL/F versus CrCl (0.86) and eGFR (0.80).
deviation.effect: The analysis plan, its endpoints, subject construction, scenarios and classification rule were locked on 31 October 2026 and are not changed by this stage; no model has been run. The relative AUC values partly overlap what the plan already recorded as known at lock (each group within +/-25% of a target at label-adjusted doses). The deviation is recorded so the result can be read with it in mind.
deviation.process_change: Further reading of this article for stage 2 starts only after this file is committed.
